ideal_cga.dictionary: normalized and symmetric subset of the energy space
ideal_cga.selection: abs(<E'(u[n-1]),g[n]>) >= t[n] sup_{g in D} abs(<E'(u[n-1]),g>)
ideal_cga.correction: u[n] in argmin_{v in span(g[1],...,g[n]) intersect dom(E)} E(v)

finite_pool_cga.reference_pool: fixed, independent seed offset 1009, diagnostic only

normalization.pure_or_regularized_p: discrete gradient Lp seminorm after zero-mean projection

acceptance: strict training-energy decrease beyond roundoff floor
